questions.prompt: A square paper is folded in half from left to right. One hole is punched near the upper-right corner of the folded rectangle. After unfolding, where are the holes?

choices.B: At the centers of the left and right edges
choices.D: One near the upper-right corner only

questions.correctAnswer: Near both upper corners
questions.explanation: Unfolding reflects the upper-right punch across the vertical centerline to the upper-left.

questions.prompt: A square paper is folded bottom to top, then left to right. One hole is punched at the exact center of the final folded square. After both folds are undone, what results?

choices.A: Two holes along the vertical centerline
choices.B: Four holes, one in each quadrant, symmetric across both centerlines
choices.C: Four holes along the top edge
choices.D: Eight holes around the border

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes, one in each quadrant, symmetric across both centerlines
questions.explanation: Reversing two perpendicular half-folds reflects the punch across both centerlines, producing four symmetric holes.

questions.prompt: A rectangular paper is folded in half from top to bottom. A triangular notch is cut from the folded edge, away from both corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: A diamond-shaped opening centered on the horizontal centerline

choices.C: One triangular notch on the top edge
choices.D: A circular opening at the center

questions.correctAnswer: A diamond-shaped opening centered on the horizontal centerline
questions.explanation: A triangular cut on the fold reflects into a matching triangle, forming a diamond-shaped opening.

questions.prompt: A square paper is folded along the diagonal from upper-left to lower-right. One hole is punched in the folded triangle away from the diagonal and all edges. After unfolding, what results?
